aggregate_query_payload_boundary.status: generic retained V56 consumer found; current exact component binding and per-axis mapping unknown
aggregate_query_payload_boundary.input: SelectInventoryStatusProgram passes request.search_data_model_container as dmc and request.search_options?.sort as option_sort to common$DataModelModifierForSearchConditionProgram.
aggregate_query_payload_boundary.output: Receives conditions, sorts, groups, flow_condition and forwards them in the read query envelope. This source does not construct individual condition_0N sort/subtotal members.
aggregate_query_payload_boundary.literal_search_payload: No search_payload literal found in inspected71 bodies; no matching named object contract established.
aggregate_query_payload_boundary.server_boundary: Read endpoint literal is /ec56/api/inventory/action/SelectInventorySearchStatusAction. Only inert source was inspected; no request was made and no server formula/field semantics inferred.

model_layout_consumer.source_contract: aggregate_key.type free selects getFreeAggregateModelInfo. It calls external common.getAggregateConditionKeys(aggregate), then emits summary1..N/subtotal1..N model references according to returned length. No condition-level asc/subtotal properties are read here.
model_layout_consumer.unknown: Helper definition, filtering/order/gap handling and dynamic summary/subtotal definitions are not retained.

mode_default.status: mode default known; axis state defaults unknown
mode_default.source_contract: InventoryStatusGetDefaultSearchOptionResolver reads aggregate.aggregate_key and defaults template_sub_type to fixed (현황), with free annotated 집계. No axis direction/subtotal default is initialized here.

last_search_snapshot.source_contract: setPageData stores cloneDeep(search_dmc.getDataModel()[0]) as ILastSearchDataModelRuntime, and last search options for non-EXCEL. It preserves a search-model snapshot, but does not identify direction/subtotal field names or prove current control state restoration.

drilldown_condition_consumer.status: separate drilldown path, not the report group builder
drilldown_condition_consumer.source_contract: getAggregateCondition keeps nonempty entries whose existing keys match condition_\d{2}, without local renumbering. generateAggregateSearchDataModel maps selected refer_type/prop_id values into clicked-row search conditions. These helpers do not read per-axis direction/subtotal state.

separate_sort_consumer.source_contract: applyInventoryStatusDefaultSortSearchOption reads template sort_search/grid sort, updates ISortInfoRuntime and SearchSortDescriptor. Other InventoryStatusSortSearchResolver code reads/writes asc_desc/subtot_tf. These are $$sort/header sorting, not evidence of $$aggregate button serialization.
